summary: @servicetitan/carto-charts-core ships preinstall dropper that executes obfuscated payload under a downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it, then uses that freshly-installed alternate runtime to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated payload with a numeric constant array, a rotating string-array unshuffler (`WV8StW`), and randomized identifier names — no readable strings and no relationship to the package's advertised purpose (an ECharts theme / chart component). Routing execution through Bun rather than Node deliberately places the payload outside the visibility of Node-based lifecycle and require-graph scanners. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope with `carto-*` naming, a ServiceTitan-branded description, and README links to `servicetitan.atlassian.net`, matching the dependency-confusion / internal-scope-impersonation shape rather than a genuine internal ServiceTitan release. On `npm install`, the obfuscated payload runs automatically on the installer's host under an unaudited runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
